{
  "schema_version": "structured_v1_icaira",
  "criterion_comparisons": [
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C2",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C2",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Recurring cash outflow is certain and board-visible; released hours are estimated and harder to attribute to savings."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C3_C5",
      "criterion_a": "C3",
      "criterion_b": "C5",
      "preferred": "C3",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Integration days hit capital budget and scarce engineering resources; throughput headroom is a technical margin, not a financial one."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C2_C4",
      "criterion_a": "C2",
      "criterion_b": "C4",
      "preferred": "C4",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Probability-weighted compliance loss threatens cash flow and reporting risk; productivity gains are softer and slower to monetize."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Annual ownership cost dominates the business case; onboarding hours are a one-time, absorbable ramp expense."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C4_C5",
      "criterion_a": "C4",
      "criterion_b": "C5",
      "preferred": "C4",
      "intensity": "very_strong",
      "reason": "Monetized exposure directly affects earnings and audit posture; throughput has no direct financial reporting consequence."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C2_C3",
      "criterion_a": "C2",
      "criterion_b": "C3",
      "preferred": "C2",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Recurring annual benefit outweighs a one-off implementation effort across the depreciation cycle."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C4",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C4",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Contracted spend is predictable and controllable; expected loss is important but probabilistic and partly insurable."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C5_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C5",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C6",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Onboarding hours are real lost productive time across all users; throughput headroom rarely binds in practice."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C3_C4",
      "criterion_a": "C3",
      "criterion_b": "C4",
      "preferred": "C4",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Annual expected loss recurs and hits reported earnings; integration effort is one-time and capitalizable."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C2_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C2",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C2",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Recurring released hours drive the return case; training time is a small, one-off offset."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C5",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C5",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "extreme",
      "reason": "Annual cost is the core budget constraint; sustained throughput carries no direct financial attribution."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C4_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C4",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C4",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Compliance loss risks material cash and reporting impact; onboarding time is minor and one-off."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C2_C5",
      "criterion_a": "C2",
      "criterion_b": "C5",
      "preferred": "C2",
      "intensity": "very_strong",
      "reason": "Released person-hours convert to quantifiable savings; throughput capacity does not appear in the benefit case."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C3",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C3",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Ongoing annual spend outweighs a single implementation effort, though integration days strain limited capex and staff."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C3_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C3",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C3",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Engineering days consume scarce capex and specialist resources; user training is cheaper and easily scheduled."
    }
  ],
  "declared_priority_order": ["C1", "C4", "C2"]
}
